original_statement: With g(u,u)=-1, Bu=0 is equivalent to (g^-1 S)u=s_t u and B=S-s_t g. Parameterize the zero-expansion rest kernel and check normalization, without inferring a timelike eigenline exists for every Lorentz-self-adjoint S.

definitions.u: real future unit timelike vector: u^T g u=-1 and u0>0
definitions.s_t: -u^T S u (normalization fixes this if a timelike eigenline is claimed)
definitions.B: S-s_t g; no assumption B u=0
definitions.mixed_S: g^-1 S; raising the first index, not Euclidean symmetry of mixed S
definitions.rest_coordinates: For the rest-kernel part use u=e0 and covariant B in the same g frame. If Bu=0 and B symmetric, the author must derive time row/column zero, then identify D=B_spatial. Zero expansion means tr(D)=0. Do not assume the requested block decomposition as a conclusion.
definitions.kernel: ker(D)={w in R^3:Dw=0}; r=dim ker(D), Euclidean spatial norm; no invertibility or nonzero eigenvalue premise
definitions.kernel_chart_candidate: Phi(w)=(sqrt(1+w.w),w) for w in ker(D), positive root. Prove exact equality with the future unit kernel fibre {v:Bv=0,v^T g v=-1,v0>0}, injectivity and inverse spatial coordinates; derive normalization and membership rather than assume them.
definitions.rest_basis: Optional orthonormal basis of ker(D) gives coordinates a in R^r, w=sum a_j E_j. If using this identification, justify its finite-dimensional existence/dimension or state a precise conditional basis theorem; do not infer global timelike eigenline existence.
definitions.norms_units: Positive Euclidean spatial norm; Lorentz g only for mass shell. S,B,s_t,D retain inverse-time units of physical-U derivative; u,w dimensionless.
definitions.branch: u0>0 and positive sqrt; past sheet is excluded
definitions.domains: All entries real; g fixed nondegenerate, S symmetric, u future mass shell. Rest zero-expansion part adds tr D=0 only because that target names zero expansion. All possible ranks and zero/repeated eigenvalue cases remain in domain.

targets_to_derive: B u=0 iff (g^-1 S)u=s_t u. The metric coefficient is uniquely fixed by mass shell; derive this, do not assume target equality.
Exact future unit kernel fibre parametrization in zero-expansion rest frame, including D=0 (r=3) and zero kernel (r=0).
No claim every Lorentz self-adjoint S has a timelike eigenline; distinguish existence conditional on an actual future unit eigenvector.
